meta.mesa_control: Voodoo Lab Control Switcher, set to PC mode (not CC). Each mesa_preset name below must be manually programmed onto Control Switcher itself (hold button 1 + button 4 while the switches are in the target combination) under the PC number listed in mesa_presets_pc, before sending this bank plan does anything useful.

mesa_preset_definitions.clean_eq_off: Channel=Clean, Solo1=off, EQ=off (featured/solo clean tone) - still programmed on Control Switcher as PC2, not used by any patch in the current single-bank layout
mesa_preset_definitions.dirty_eq_off: Channel=Dirty, Solo1=off, EQ=off - still programmed on Control Switcher as PC4, not used by any patch in the current single-bank layout

switchtrack_pc_meanings_in_use.1: A only - Peavey audible, Mesa silent
switchtrack_pc_meanings_in_use.3: B only - Mesa audible, Peavey silent

meta.switchtrack_note: 2026-10-24: the guitar goes straight into the Switch-Track (the only audio device on the pedalboard; effects are the Daisy Seed in the amps' FX loops), and both amps are behind it - OUTA = Peavey, OUTB = Mesa (factory presets 1/3/5/7). Each patch's switchtrack_pc_channel2 follows from which amps are audible (peavey.present, mesa_preset != 'muted'); bank_plan.py checks this and refuses to build on a mismatch. Before 2026-10-24 only Peavey was on the Switch-Track (OUTA, PC1/PC7) and Mesa sat on the SCF Gold's left leg.
meta.daisy_note: Daisy Seed (daisy-fx) answers program changes on MIDI ch3 only and boots on program 126, dry. 126 and 127 are reserved in the Daisy's firmware, never files on its card; programs 0-125 are its patches. Program 127 mutes the Daisy (5 ms fade, echo and reverb trails dropped); the two mute presets send it, so the Mesa's loop, which the FCB can't switch off, is silent too. Every patch sets daisy_pc explicitly, so pressing a preset always sets the Daisy; a patch picked on the Daisy's own buttons lasts until the next FCB press. The Daisy's MIDI IN is at the end of the chain (after the Switch-Track). daisy_patches names the patches on its card.
meta.peavey_switching: Peavey Bandit's TRS footswitch jack (TIP = FX loop, RING = channel) is split by a TRS-to-2xTS Y cable (replaced the old tip/ring-swapped cable 2026-10-24, which grounded the loop contact and held the loop off). RING -> FCB1010 SWITCH1 = channel, set per patch by fcb_switch1_relay (on=dirty, off=clean; confirmed on SWITCH1 2026-10-24). TIP -> SWITCH2 = FX loop: on when peavey.present is true, off when Peavey is muted.
meta.peavey_fx_loop_note: peavey_fx_loop_switch2_relay is the SWITCH2 relay state that turns the Peavey's FX loop ON ('on' = closed; confirmed 2026-10-24: with SWITCH2 open the loop was off). The loop is on in every patch where peavey.present is true, so the Daisy Seed (Peavey on its left in/out, Mesa on the right) isn't bypassed, and off where Peavey is muted.
meta.peavey_mute_note: Peavey muted (peavey.present false) = three things together: Switch-Track PC7, FX loop OFF (SWITCH2 open), and channel CLEAN (SWITCH1 open). Clean is required to make it quiet - Switch-Track mute plus loop off on the dirty channel is not silent. bank_plan.py forces clean on every muted patch regardless of fcb_switch1_relay. Noted 2026-10-24.
meta.mesa_modes_note: Single bank (bank 0) since 2026-10-05; the old 3-bank layout is in git history. Switches 1-4 are both amps (Switch-Track A+B), clean to dirty: Mesa clean/Peavey clean, Mesa clean/Peavey dirty, Mesa dirty/Peavey clean, Mesa dirty/Peavey dirty. Switches 6-9 are one amp each: Mesa clean, Peavey clean, Mesa dirty, Peavey dirty. Switches 5 and 10 are the only full mutes (Switch-Track PC7). Mesa uses EQ-on presets only; the EQ-off presets aren't used by any patch.

patches.function: Mesa Clean EQ-on + Peavey Clean (both clean)
Mesa Dirty EQ-on + Peavey Dirty (both dirty)
